'''Dušan Velič''' (15 October 1966 – 31 July 2023) was a Slovak [[Physical chemistry|physical chemist]] and politician. He served as a State Secretary at the Ministry of Investment, Regional Development, and Informatization from April 2021 to May 2023.<ref name ="PL">{{cite web |title=Novým štátnym tajomníkom MIRRI je Velič {{!}} Parlamentné Listy |url=https://www.parlamentnelisty.sk/arena/427380/novym-statnym-tajomnikom-mirri-je-velic/ |website=Parlamentne Listy |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk-SK |date=14 April 2021}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Dušan Velič was born on 15 October 1966 in [[Žilina]].<ref>{{cite web |title=prof. Ing. Dušan Velič, PhD. |url=https://dusanvelic.sk/ |website=dusanvelic.sk |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk-SK}}</ref> He studied at the [[Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava]], graduating in 1990. Following his graduation, he went on to get his PhD at the [[Wayne State University]], which he obtained in 1996.<ref name ="uniba">{{cite web |title=Smutná správa z PriF UK: odišiel profesor Dušan Velič |url=https://uniba.sk/spravodajsky-portal/detail-aktuality/back_to_page/aktuality-43/article/smutna-sprava-z-prif-uk-odisiel-profesor-dusan-velic/ |website=uniba.sk |language=sk-SK}}</ref>

== Academic career ==
After his PhD, Velič spent two years as a [[postdoctoral researcher]] at the [[Fritz Haber Institute of the Max Planck Society]]. In 1998, he joined the [[Comenius University]], where he taught until his death.<ref name="uniba" /> He became a full professor at the Comenius University in 2021.<ref>{{cite web |title=Prezidentka vymenovala 27 nových vysokoškolských profesorov |url=https://www.teraz.sk/slovensko/prezidentka-vymenovala-27-novych-vysoko/545434-clanok.html |website=TERAZ.sk |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk |date=29 April 2021}}</ref> In the early 2000s, he co-founded the International Laser Centre in Bratislava, where he remained active until his death.<ref>{{cite web |title=Zahynul bývalý Remišovej tajomník Dušan Velič. Matovič: Kamko, odpočívaj v pokoji |url=https://spravy.pravda.sk/domace/clanok/676477-tragicka-nehoda-v-centre-bratislavy-zahynul-byvaly-statny-tajomnik-dusan-velic-kandidoval-za-za-olano/ |website=Pravda.sk |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk-SK |date=31 July 2023}}</ref>

== Political career ==
Dušan Velič joined the Slovak government as a State Secretary at the Ministry of Investment, Regional Development in April 2021, following the resignation of [[Vladimír Ledecký]].<ref name="PL" /> In the [[2022 Slovak regional elections]], he ran for the Governor of the [[Bratislava Region]] with the endorsement of the [[For the People (Slovakia)|For the People]] and [[We Are Family (Slovakia)|We Are Family]] parties. He finished fourth with 8.08 % of the vote.<ref>{{cite web |title=Bratislavský kraj - Výsledky volieb do VÚC 2022 (župné voľby) |url=https://volby.sme.sk/volby-vuc/2022/vysledky/bratislavsky-kraj |website=volby.sme.sk |language=sk}}</ref> He was poised to run also in the [[2023 Slovak parliamentary election]], on the list of the [[Ordinary People and Independent Personalities|OĽaNO]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Bývalý štátny tajomník Dušan Velič zomrel pri nehode |url=https://dennikn.sk/minuta/3501032/ |website=Denník N |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk-SK |date=31 July 2023}}</ref>

== Personal life and death ==
Dušan Velič died on 31 July 2023, when his motorbike crashed into a car that entered the road from an adjacent parking lot. He was 56.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Tomečková |first1=Nicol |title=Pri tragickej nehode zomrel bývalý štátny tajomník |url=https://spravy.rtvs.sk/2023/07/pri-tragickej-nehode-v-bratislave-zomrel-byvaly-statny-tajomnik-dusan-velic/ |website=Správy RTVS |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk-SK |date=31 July 2023}}</ref>

Velič was the uncle of the OĽaNO MP [[Andrej Stančík]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Politici reagujú na smrť Dušana Veliča: Spomienky, nesplnené plány aj slová sústrasti |url=https://plus.noviny.sk/819600-politici-reaguju-na-smrt-dusana-velica-spomienky-nesplnene-plany-aj-slova-sustrasti?_gl=1*1nuxh*_ga*MjEwMjIwMjE3MS4xNjg0OTEzMzI3*_ga_RHR53MHYFE*MTY5MDg3NDQyNi44LjAuMTY5MDg3NDQyNi4wLjAuMA.. |website=plus.noviny.sk |access-date=1 August 2023 |language=sk |date=31 July 2023}}</ref>
